ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-08-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: James Robertson II, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: B. Fields, #7235

Petitioners Mei Chun Lok (mom) were present in pro per for self and as Guardian Ad Litem for the Minor Siu Hang Lee and Siu Ho Lee, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is in the file.
Co-Petitioner Kwong Chung Lee (father) was not present but consented to the name change of the two minors.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Queenie Meichun Lok and change name of the Minors to Andrew Siu Hang Lee and Kenneth Siu Ho Lee.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
